about: Byte caps on the tools/list result (compact JSON, as the stdio shim writes it) per schema profile, protocol version and role profile. Measured 2026-09-25 (WS-54); remember content made optional and the WS-19A lifecycle arguments added as Advanced 2026-09-26, and the WS-19B provenance and evidence-bound vote arguments the same day (full caps grew by exactly their cost each time). WS-21 (2026-09-28): why_failed run_id became optional and the tool non-read-only (it runs commands); its lean entry stayed the same size at 2025-06-18 and shrank by 44 bytes at 2024-11-05 (caps lowered), and the full caps grew by exactly the cost of its five advanced source arguments. Lower a cap when the list shrinks; never raise one to fit an addition: advertise less (declare the argument Advanced, documented at xmustard://docs/tools) or trim a description. cmd/xmustard-api checks role_profiles against the route gates.
